text:
anya: Heads-up — seeing a small but steady eviction/drain loop in eu-west1-b for GPU workloads. A few training-worker pods keep getting evicted and rescheduled across AZs, then evicted again. Noticed after the autoscaler added nodes ~30m ago.

devin: Confirmed. autoscaler added 2 nodes in eu-west1-b and they immediately filled with small inference jobs. Then long-running training pods couldn't land due to anti-affinity/soft nodeAffinity and PDBs. :thinking:

kai: Can you paste the pod + node view? Want to check topologySpread/affinity and taints.

anya: Pasted snippets below — the affected pods are CrashLoop/evicted.
```
kubectl get pods -n ml -o wide | grep training-worker
training-worker-7   0/1 CrashLoopBackOff   1 (Evicted)   eu-west1-b   10.10.3.45   node-3 (gpu=1)
training-worker-9   1/1 Running            0              eu-west1-c   10.10.4.12   node-7 (gpu=1)
```

Node list snippet:
```
NAME     ZONE        GPU  TAINTS
node-3   eu-west1-b  1    dedicated=reserved:NoSchedule
node-5   eu-west1-b  1    
node-7   eu-west1-c  1    
```

marta: Looks like a mix of soft anti-affinity + PDBs blocking quick relocations. The scheduler prefers spread across AZs, but when nodes fill, pods race and get preempted or OOMKilled and then bounce.

kai: Our workload has a preferredDuringScheduling topologySpread + soft nodeAffinity to avoid colocating experiments. That makes binpacking leave 1-GPU holes across many nodes => fragmentation.

devin: I also noticed some node labels were inconsistent (region vs zone tags), might make scheduler view of capacity slightly off when matching nodeSelector.

ops-bot: autoscaler: added 2 nodes in eu-west1-b at 2026-03-17T14:12:03Z

anya: Short-term mitigation proposal: temporarily relax the anti-affinity for training-worker (allowSameNode: true), reduce PDB minAvailable by 1 for rollout window, and deploy a descheduler job to consolidate tiny inference pods so training can land.

kai: +1 to descheduler. We should use RemovePodsViolatingInterPodAntiAffinity + LowNodeUtilization policy and run it on a low cadence (every 5m) for the next 2 hours.

marta: I'll open an infra ticket (INF-3245) with the change plan, rollback steps, and cost estimate. Will run the change in staging canary first.

devin: I'll prepare a PR to eng-platform: add a namespaced descheduler CronJob and a small kube patch to the training workload to flip anti-affinity to preferred. Will include tests for node label normalization.

anya: Thank you. I'll monitor eviction metrics and per-AZ GPU utilization. Preliminary rough calc: ~8% extra vGPU hours wasted during these reschedules in the past 24h — want to get that down.

kai: Also adding an alert: per-AZ GPU fragmentation ratio (free GPUs on nodes with <cpu-threshold) + rising pod eviction rate. If the alert fires we auto-run the consolidate descheduler job.

marta: Assigned INF-3245 to @devin and @anya. ETA for canary change: 2h.

devin: On it. Will report back with PR link and staging run results.
